summary: Use bounded source-change hints for idle Web history polling without reading message or event bodies.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing SessionStore/EventStore and Web history adapter; no new authority or service.
components.disposition: Opaque optional revision hint derived from filesystem identities of session JSON and bounded event segment metadata. No body reads, no authority or snapshot cursor. Before/after first-page comparison; unknown or changed hint falls back to normal history. Periodic latest-message probe preserves a recovery path. Epoch and in-flight guard prevent late/overlapping probes. Complete JSON cache also invalidates same-size/mtime replacement. No data migration or model context changes.
evidence: 96 targeted Python tests passed; 26 frontend tests passed; Ruff and TypeScript typecheck passed.
Isolated synthetic 100/1k/10k/100k message revision function P95 0.010/0.010/0.010/0.011 ms, 100 samples per size, one event file and warm identity cache; not HTTP or production performance.
Regression tests cover event-only retraction, same-size replacement, changed earlier segment, bounded scan fallback, no full body read, frontend change/unknown/stale session.
components.verification_level: Targeted isolated tests passed; independent final SHA review, original R9, remote CI and production acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Veto if the hint is treated as authorization, proof of exact hydration, or a stable paging cursor; retain ordinary history and fallback on unknown source. True storage pagination remains a separate M1b deliverable.
components.rollback_route: Revert this patch; old clients ignore optional field and new clients fall back when endpoint absent. No durable schema change.
